title: TakeawayBastions
description: A Bastion addon to the TakeawayGuard plugin.
body:
TakeawayBastions introduces physical area control fields that prevent enemies from bypassing your defenses. It stops Ender Pearls, drags Elytra fliers out of the sky, and prevents block placement to stop pillaring.

Requires: TakeawayGuard
This plugin will not load without the core plugin installed.

**Look for dev builds of TakeawayBastions on the [Github Release](https://github.com/doccyt/TakeawaySnitches)**

**If you have any issues report them on the [discord server](https://discord.gg/DfWRnvmSkb)**

**Find more of my plugins and mods check out my [Website!](https://doccdev.xyz/)**

What does TakeawayBastions add? glad you asked!
Three Protection Tiers:

Basic Bastion: 10 Radius. Good for small outposts.

Town Bastion: 50 Radius. Protects an entire base.

City Bastion: 100 Radius. Dominate the map.

Anti-Pearl Field:

Any Ender Pearl thrown into or within the field is instantly destroyed.

Players receive a heavy "Thud" sound and an Action Bar warning.

Elytra Brake:

Enemies gliding into the field are forcibly dragged to the ground.

Disables fireworks and flight mechanics inside the radius.

Siege Mechanics (Erosion):

Bastions are not infinite. Blocking a pearl or stopping a flight drains the Bastion's "Erosion" health.

When erosion hits 0, the Bastion breaks violently.

How to Use
Reinforce the Ground: Bastions must be placed on a block reinforced by TakeawayGuard.

Place the Bastion: Place a Bone Block on top of the reinforced block.

Visualise: The block will automatically activate based on your crafting recipe tier. Type /bastion show to see the field boundaries.

Commands
/bastion [show] - View the bastion's health, type, and visualize the field borders with particles.

/tb give <player> <BASIC|TOWN|CITY> - (Admin) Give a pre-meta Bastion block.
